items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Alan King, Burgaard Adams were with the Nighthawks.

ctx.x: And you mentioned him with the Nighthawks, too. Cormick Scott. Was he with the Nighthawks? No. No, he wasn't with the Nighthawks. I got it. No.
Alan King, Burgaard Adams were with the Nighthawks.
Mm-hmm. Now, Burgaard Adams was an alto player, you said. Burgaard Adams played alto.
